scientific_integrity: One self-contained mathematical claim with an analytic proof and supplementary exact symbolic checks; no independent external audit or certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Convex planar polygons only, nonnegative rational generalized barycentric coordinates with a common polynomial denominator. The adjoint-degree dichotomy is an established cited theorem; the minimum-denominator equality is newly proved here. Not extended to higher-dimensional polytopes.
title: Wachspress denominators have minimum degree on every convex polygon
